summary: Blast aliens, upgrade your chopper, and save the farm in this wacky runner!
description: 🛸 Aliens are stealing Pops' precious corn harvest, and it’s time to harvest them instead! Hop onto your heavily armed corn chopper, dodge deadly tractor beams, and mow down endless hordes of little blue invaders in this high-octane farm defense runner. Help Pops, Joe, and Otis protect their turf in a crazy adventure that mixes redneck ingenuity with explosive sci-fi action. The martians might have spaceships and all-devouring trolls, but you have a combine harvester packed with jury-rigged weaponry! Turn their own advanced alien technology against them to trigger massive power boosts and show the galaxy how Earth handles an invasion. 🌽 KEY FEATURES 👽 • PLAY WITHOUT ADS! • Spaced-Out Runner Action: Plow through farm obstacles, shoot down UFOs, and survive high-speed chases in an endless alien-busting ride! • Insane Vehicle Upgrades: Trick out your deadly harvester with tons of tuning parts and unleash a huge arsenal of homemade weapons. • Alien Tech Power-Ups: Collect extraterrestrial technology to activate massive game-changing boosts and crush the martian trolls. • Unfold the Story: Unlock hilarious diary entries to reveal the full, wacky narrative behind the invasion. • Endless Challenges: Master dozens of achievements and test your reflexes in continuous, fast-paced runs. • Full Controller Support: Play your way with seamless gamepad integration. Supports Google Play game services! Supported languages: EN, FR, DE, ID, IT, JA, KO, PT, RU, ZH-CN, ES, SV, ZH-TW Thank you for playing ‘Farm Invasion USA’! © THQ Nordic Mobile 2026
